test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Eloquent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Eloquent** means being able to use language and express your opinions well, especially when you speak in public.

 ** • Example-** I heard him make a very eloquent speech at that dinner. 

 
• So, it is clear that** 'Eloquent' **can be used as a one-word substitute for **'Fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Presenter** means a person who introduces a television or radio programme.
 
• **Magnificent** means extremely impressive and attractive.
 
• **Persuader** means a person who persuades someone to do something.
